content:
President Trump launched scathing attacks late Friday night against several former allies, calling them "losers" and hurling personal insults.

"Tucker Carlson just met with insignificant 'former' Congressman Thomas Massie, and Marjorie 'TRAITOR' Greene, they are all LOSERS! Tucker's 'influence' is at an all-time low, and it will only get worse," Trump wrote on Truth Social at 10:37 p.m. Friday. "No one cares about him anymore, he has become completely irrelevant, and surprisingly, he is a very low IQ person."

Carlson broke with the Republican Party earlier this year after publicly criticizing the administration's war against Iran. He has since teamed up with other right-wing Trump critics, including former Georgia Republican Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene and Republican (Kentucky) Congressman Thomas Massie, to plot a third-party alternative as the rift within the MAGA camp widens.

The president's lengthy tirade on Friday night was his latest in a string of attacks against prominent former supporters. He told supporters that Carlson "could barely make it through, probably didn't even graduate, but only really stupid people are unable to endure four wonderful years of college!"

"Tucker wants to run for public office, but he should be required to take a cognitive exam. He doesn't have a chance, but might take a few votes away from the Republican ticket! Tucker is a LOSER, and has always been!" Trump continued.

The president then turned his sights on Greene. Greene broke with Trump over the administration's handling of the Epstein files and the war against Iran. He called the 52-year-old Greene "a highly neurotic young woman who has gone from super conservative to liberal 'FOOL' in just a few short weeks."

The former congresswoman responded to Trump on Saturday with lengthy posts mocking his slipping poll numbers and expressing regret for having once supported him.

She wrote: "President Trump's attitude, insults, absurd and reckless rhetoric are completely unbecoming of the presidency, a poor example of leadership that is harming America's reputation and standing in the world. At this point, he is hardly different from the mean-spirited comments made by internet trolls or the millions of bots online."

Trump also insulted Massie, calling him "a failed politician, and a real jerk." The Kentucky congressman had stirred controversy by heavily advocating for the release of the Epstein files, ultimately losing the Republican primary to a Trump-backed challenger.

"He thinks it's cool to vote 'NO' on every bill, no matter how good, strong, or appropriate it may be. These three LOSERS together will be quite an interesting combo, not worth even a penny! Their only chance is to join the radical Left Democrats, and try to gain a foothold in the primary system. To all of them, I say — Praise be to Allah!" Trump concluded his lengthy rant.

Massie noted on X that Trump's post came shortly after he unveiled a so-called "disastrous beef policy" that sparked fierce backlash within the Republican Party, while the U.S. national debt has reached $40 trillion, partly due to the president's endorsement of the so-called "one big, beautiful bill."
